note: Real detections from `bun scripts/face-detect.ts <url>`, recorded so the framing tests run offline and without the optional detector installed. Re-run that command if a photo changes.

denzo.note: Denzo's profile photo, Sep 2026: a tight portrait headshot. The face is 56% of the image height, so a 16:9 cover crop cannot hold it and the framing has to fall back to contain.

denzoExif6.note: The same photo stored sideways: 1696x1272 pixels with EXIF orientation 6, the way a phone writes a portrait shot. It presents as 1272x1696, and the detector must report the box in that frame - identical to `denzo` above.

l4c4.note: L4C4 shot wide in an armchair: a small face high in a portrait frame, which a cover crop can slide onto.
